name: meshit
description: Lightweight threaded LoRa chat for ESP32 and nRF52840

scripts.test: python3 tools/test_core.py && python3 tools/build_sim.py && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:prepare && node tools/add-mobile.mjs android
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:prepare && node tools/add-mobile.mjs ios
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && node tools/configure-mobile.mjs && cap sync && node tools/ios-bluetooth-spm.mjs
scripts.build:firmware: pio run -e heltec-v3 -e heltec-v4 -e heltec-v4-3 -e rak4631 -e rak4631-s140-6-1-1 -e heltec-t114
